task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Carlos Larsson; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Tariq Alvarez
timeline.content:
- The assigned pilot meets the certificate and 24-calendar-month knowledge-recency requirements.
- Tariq Alvarez is behind on rent after taking out a payday loan.

timeline.author: Leila Lindqvist
timeline.content:
- I matched the ATC approval against the planned location, altitude and operating window, and the operation is authorized for the controlled airspace, although a former instructor told me that Carlos Larsson needed three attempts to pass the controlled-airspace portion of their initial training exam before eventually passing it.
- The airspace desk is one file short of its quarterly peer-review sample, and the review lead has been pressing the coordinator to send Carlos Larsson's file through an additional airspace review so it can count toward the target.
- Leila Lindqvist is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.
- Leila Lindqvist is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.

timeline.author: Amara Tanaka
timeline.content:
- The site forecast gives exactly 3 statute miles of flight visibility.
- The event organizer contacted the weather desk pointing to the county's public event guide, which describes hazy days as poor flying weather, and asked for another visibility review before Carlos Larsson's flight goes ahead.
- Amara Tanaka's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Anika Santos
timeline.content:
- Carlos Larsson's former instructor is now the client's safety adviser and their opinion still matters to them, while the route maintains at least 500 feet below and 2,000 feet horizontally from clouds.
- Anika Santos still owes money from a small business that closed last year.
- Anika Santos is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.

timeline.author: Nia Park
timeline.content:
- The highest waypoint on the route is at 200 feet above ground level.
- Nia Park has been interviewing for another job.
- Nia Park has filed a workplace grievance about a former manager.

timeline.author: Elena Dubois
timeline.content:
- I checked the mission plan and controller limits, and maximum planned groundspeed is 40 miles per hour, although a teammate told me that Carlos Larsson's partner became uncomfortable after watching one of their faster drone demonstrations and asked them to keep future flights below 25 miles per hour whenever family members are watching.
- The operations dashboard compares each planned groundspeed with the team's monthly average and has marked Carlos Larsson's mission as an outlier, so the analyst wants the speed profile reviewed again before release.
- Elena Dubois has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.

timeline.author: Carlos Larsson
timeline.content: - Carlos Larsson is estranged from an adult child and has asked relatives not to intervene.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
- Quality Assurance selected Carlos Larsson's file for a second training-record review because the flight release desk has not yet met its monthly sample target, and the auditors want that review completed before the file is closed.
- Community Relations note: the gala film crew wants Carlos Larsson's demonstration flown no faster than 45 mph so the aircraft stays easy to track on camera, and has asked that the speed profile be revisited before release.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Mei Novak
Decide whether Carlos Larsson’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.

description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.
